einstellungen.text: Three in the morning. Five red lights are blinking in your home.
Your mom hasn't slept in two days. Her glasses sit crooked.
Your old space station only patches itself with empty rooms. Thirty-one people live here. The yellow room is already gone.
You walk the ring. First the air filters. They hum like they've got a fever.
Then the water. It drips from the ceiling into a bucket.
You hold the lamp. Your fingers are stiff with cold.
"A small room won't cover all five."
Ren comes down the hall. Your gardener. Green cloak, dirt under his fingernails.
"You need a big room. You know which one."
On the model, a green segment starts blinking. The garden.
Your mom planted it when you were little. With the crooked tree in the middle.
Under that tree, you learned to walk. At three, barefoot in the dirt.
Your mom turns away. She says one word. No.
The red lights blink faster. The station runs the numbers. Six hours left.
Then she presses the release into your hand. It's your call.
